summary: Nothing new and verified since the booked Huang resignation: no named permanent CEO, no guidance change, no new export or antitrust action found for Nov 12-13. Coverage is rehash of the resignation, succession speculation and the Nov 17 earnings preview.

items.headline: NVIDIA 8-K Item 5.02/9.01: CEO transition (Huang resignation, Kress interim CEO)
items.why: Already booked (key-person factor); it is the only NVDA 8-K filed in the window per the EDGAR filing list.

items.headline: Headhunters may be scouting Nvidia successors, The Information reports (names Lisa Su, Rene Haas, Ian Buck, Kress)
items.why: Dated Nov 10, before the window, and speculation only; no board decision on a permanent CEO. Permanent CEO naming would be a new trigger event when it happens.

items.headline: Q3 earnings previews and succession commentary ahead of the Nov 17 print
items.why: Opinion and expectations, no new company facts; Q3 date unchanged (Nov 17).
